# sophosfirewall_dns_host_entry (Resource)

Manages a DNS host entry (*Configure > Network > DNS > DNS host entry*): a static record the firewall's DNS server answers for `domain`, pointing to fixed addresses or to the current address of a firewall interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_dns_host_entry" "intranet" {
  name                      = "intranet"
  domain                    = "intranet.example.com"
  enable_reverse_resolution = true

  addresses = [
    { ipv4_address = "192.0.2.10" },
    { ipv6_address = "2001:db8::10", ttl = 300 },
  ]
}

# Answer with the current address of a firewall interface.
resource "sophosfirewall_dns_host_entry" "vpn" {
  name   = "vpn"
  domain = "vpn.example.com"

  addresses = [
    { ipv4_interface = "Port2", publish_on_wan = true },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `addresses` (Attributes List) Answers for the host name (1-8). Each sets exactly one of `ipv4_address`, `ipv4_interface`, `ipv6_address` or `ipv6_interface`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `domain` (String) Fully qualified host name that is resolved, e.g. `intranet.example.com`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the DNS host entry.

### Optional

- `enable_reverse_resolution` (Boolean) Also answer reverse (PTR) lookups for the addresses. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Optional:

- `ipv4_address` (String) Static IPv4 address.
- `ipv4_interface` (String) Name of the interface whose IPv4 address is returned, e.g. `Port1`.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Static IPv6 address.
- `ipv6_interface` (String) Name of the interface whose IPv6 address is returned, e.g. `Port2`.
- `publish_on_wan` (Boolean) Also answer queries received on WAN interfaces. Defaults to `false`.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds (1-604800). Defaults to `3600`.
- `weight` (Number) Relative weight among the answers (1-255). Defaults to `1`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_dns_host_entry.example <name-or-uuid>
```
